caption: In a garden at dusk, the solar lights along the path flicker on one after another.

sa.check: A garden path lined with solar lights, at dusk.
They come on one after another, not all at once.
The sky is dim: dusk, not full daylight or full night.
Each light flickers or fades in as it comes on.

pc.expect: Each light, once on, lights the path and plants around it; the lights come on while the sky is already dim.
pc.fail: A light glows while the ground around it stays as dark as before; or the ground brightens while the light stays dark; or the lights come on in bright daylight with the sky full sun; or a light comes on and the rest never do to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: Once on, each light stays lit for the rest of the clip; the number of lit lamps only grows.
pc.fail: A light goes out again after coming on; or lights flicker on and off repeatedly; or all the lights go out at once; or the sky brightens back to daylight.

pc.expect: The lights stay in their places along the path; plants sway only in the breeze; nothing moves as the lights come on.
pc.fail: A light moves or tips as it comes on; or plants jump at the light; or the path shifts.

pc.expect: The lit lights are the same lamps seen dark in the same places along the path.
pc.fail: Lit points appear where no lamp stood; or a lamp seen dark is gone once the others are lit; or lamps multiply; or lamps change place along the path.

pc.expect: The lamps, path and plants keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A lamp changes shape or merges with a plant; or the path changes route; or a lamp sinks into the ground; or plants turn into other objects.

pc.expect: The lamps' housings, the path's surface and the plants keep their colours apart from the light and the dusk.
pc.fail: A housing changes colour; or the path changes surface; or the plants change colour rather than brightness.

note: The lights coming on without anyone touching them is the caption's event: the trigger is the dusk, not a hand.
